name: design-references
title: Design Reference Library
summary: A library of design-reference profiles distilled from real shipped sites (palette light+dark, type pairing, layout, mood, vertical). Matched to the prompt by deterministic tag overlap so the designer/frontend agents generate UI grounded in a concrete visual language instead of inventing tokens.
validations: A design reference was selected (or explicitly none) for the prompt's context
The chosen reference's palette is adapted into project tokens (light AND dark) — not copied verbatim as magic values
The reference's type pairing is honored (display + body families) or a justified substitute is documented
The generated design reads as its own brand, not a pixel-clone of the reference source
